items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: Marian McPartland listened to him [Joe Morello], and the rest is history.

ctx.x: That a returning serviceman was entitled to his job if he wanted it.
Exactly. So Joe Rasch wanted his job back and Joe Morello was out and with no job they brought him down to New York City, and Marian McPartland listened to him, and the rest is history.
It was at the Hickory House.
